answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose a model to improve the factual consistency of system summaries with post-editing correction

answer_2.quote: We report accuracy, as well as precision, recall, and F1

answer_4.quote: We instead conducted a human evaluation to check the consistency of the corrected output. We read the original and corrected summaries as well as the source document to determine whether a summary is successfully corrected by our model
answer_4.guideline: determine whether a summary is successfully corrected by our model
